purpose: One-way absence-check fingerprints for omitted coefficient/derived-value data. No coefficients, reconstructed source data or scientific assertions are distributed in this fixture. Bibliographic references are intentionally retained separately.
normalization: Decimal(str(token)).normalize() under local decimal Context(prec=28); SHA256 of UTF-8 normalized string. Only derived values with at least eight significant digits are fingerprinted; this is a regression check, not exhaustive proof.
